content.text:
I've built the Rotaline landing page as a single `index.html` with all 11 sections, using the copy, names and numbers from your brief. I checked it in headless Chrome at 1440px and at 390px. The 390px check ran inside a 390px iframe, because headless Chrome wouldn't open a window that narrow. Neither width shows sideways scrolling or clipped content. That pass turned up some overlapping elements and badly aligned avatar initials, which I fixed and re-checked. The billing toggle, the FAQ and the email form are untested: none of the screenshots exercised them.

**How it behaves**
- **Navigation on small screens:** below 900px wide, the header links collapse into a menu button. The menu closes when you pick a link or press Escape.
- **Hero illustration:** built in HTML/CSS. It shows a week of shifts for a "Payments API" service: three rotation rows, named people in colored blocks, and a red "Now" marker on Thursday. On top of it sit a handoff note from Maya Chen to Jonah Park, with an open incident carried over, and an "alert acknowledged" card. On phones these cards stack under the schedule instead of overlapping it.
- **Pricing:** the Monthly / Annual toggle switches Team between $9 and $7 and Business between $16 and $13, and changes the "Billed monthly / Billed annually" line under each price. Team is marked "Most popular".
- **FAQ:** the five questions open and close with the browser's built-in expand/collapse element, so they work even without JavaScript.
- **Email form:** checks that the address looks valid. It then shows a confirmation message but doesn't send anything anywhere.
- **Look:** warm off-white background, orange accent, dark band for the results figures. Fonts come from Google Fonts, with system fonts as a fallback when offline. Every icon, logo and illustration is inline SVG or CSS; there are no external images.

**Copy I added that you didn't specify:** short intros for each section, a "New" badge in the hero, small text under each how-it-works step, the five FAQ answers, and plan descriptions. Three additions make claims you may want to check or cut:
- "Save up to 22% with annual billing" next to the pricing toggle. Business works out to 19% and Team to 22%.
- A note under the results saying the missed-pages figure compares each team's first 90 days on Rotaline with the 90 days before.
- "All systems operational" in the footer.
